url.title: URL to screenshot
url.description: Page address, e.g. https://example.com. The baseline for this URL is kept in your own Apify storage.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: true = the whole scrollable page, false = only the visible screen.

width.title: Viewport width
width.description: Browser window width in CSS pixels. Different widths keep separate baselines.

height.title: Viewport height
height.description: Browser window height in CSS pixels. Different heights keep separate baselines.

format.title: Image format
format.description: png keeps pixel-perfect detail, jpeg is smaller. Different formats keep separate baselines.

diffPixels.title: Pixel sensitivity
diffPixels.description: How much a channel must change (0-255) for a pixel to count as changed. Higher = ignores soft noise, lower = catches subtle shifts.

waitFor.title: Extra wait (ms)
waitFor.description: Time to wait after load, for animations and lazy images.

resetBaseline.title: Reset baseline
resetBaseline.description: true = forget the stored screenshot for this URL and treat this run as a new baseline.
